prompt_text: Who does backflow testing and repair near Liberty MO?
answer_verbatim:

If you want the quick how-to now, here’s what will be most useful:

Where to look
- Local plumbing contractors that list “backflow testing” or “backflow prevention” services
- Irrigation/sprinkler companies (often test backflow devices)
- HVAC/water-treatment companies that do cross-connection control
- National plumbers with local branches (e.g., Roto-Rooter) if you prefer a chain
- City of Liberty / Liberty Water Department or Public Works — they often maintain a list of certified testers or have requirements/permits

How to verify a provider
- Ask for their backflow tester certification (state or third-party). Many jurisdictions require testers to be certified; get the tester’s name and certification number.
- Verify insurance and business license.
- Ask if they’re registered with the City of Liberty (if required).
- Ask for recent references or online reviews.

Typical costs (ballpark)
- Annual test: commonly $60–$150 per device (depends on device type and access)
- Minor repairs: $75–$300
- Major repairs or replacement: $300–$1,000+ (depends on part and labor)
Prices vary — get a written estimate.

Questions to ask when you call
- “Are you certified to perform backflow assembly tests in Missouri? What’s your tester’s name and certification number?”
- “Do you perform repairs and replacements, or only testing?”
- “What will the test/remedial work cost? Any trip or service fees?”
- “Do you provide a written test/report suitable for the city/utility?”
